description: This is a PHP source file for a subpanel viewer in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM module, handling request validation, setup of subpanel display, and rendering of the subpanel in the context of a CRM module.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: Represents the subpanel component responsible for displaying related records within a module's detail view.

methods.name: setTemplateFile
methods.description: Sets the template file used for rendering the subpanel.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Retrieves the HTML for action buttons associated with the subpanel.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the subpanel content, optionally only counting records.
